flags.observation: No style text accompanies the candidate; style fit judged only on lyric cadence and format against the golden example.
"bills for bad dreams" is a coined slogan, not the deck thesis in plain words; the title premise "Kicks Out at Two" never surfaces.
Only one onboarding beat; nobody says who speaks or what the listener is doing here. Punch "It was free." lands ambiguously.
No expert dog whistle anywhere in intro or outro; deck insider material (dates, terms, quotes) appears only inside card lines.
Outro callback targets card imagery (teeth, cards 4 and 17); link to "charged me for a nightmare" is thematic, not an intro image.
Across sixteen openers almost none carry so/but/until/except logic from the previous card; most are labels echoing their own card (Tip 1 unmet).
Opener "Blocked? Retreat:" repeats the card's own word "blocked"; no therefore/but link to the preceding Displacement card.
"Until seven:" pre-announces "seven A.M." from the same line; no twist relation to Somatic Stimulus before it.
"Patient:" is a bare label with no causal or twist relation to The Alarm Clock before it.
"Yet the case:" is semantically unclear, and a second colon after "ultimate plot twist" makes the beat hard to parse aloud.
"The patient asks:" contradicts the card: "lie down, don't look at me" is the analyst speaking, not the patient.
"Parent:" duplicates "the internalized parent" in the same line; a label, not a bridge.
"Before ink:" plus "before the Censor" doubles the word in one breath; ink is not an artworkPrompt image word.
114 characters with "The detective finds hunger:"; hunger repeats at line end. Not sayable in one breath.
110 characters; "A censored gap: The Gap" stacks the same word twice before the card even starts.
"losing a tooth in a dream, not dentists" drops the verb from "isn't about dentists"; the clause garbles when spoken.
"why back?" is a clipped stub of "Why are you back here?"; stumbles in performance.
Cutting "Paved with" leaves "Royal Road to Unconscious, bad intentions and dirty jokes" without the card's claim linking road and jokes.
"kicked out of the room" adds "of the room", which is not in the card lore.
"five faces smash into one monster" makes the faces the agent; card says "you can smash five faces".
